purpose: Independent, dated re-verification of the live published snapshot and of the two phone-summary labelling defects fixed in this session. Nothing in this file is a probability input; no pick, price, alias or source capture was changed by the audit.

audit_window.performed_from: Arena sandbox (read-only web fetches and the GitHub Contents API); the four-hour collector itself was not run
audit_window.timezone_note: All instants are UTC. The rendered Hotspawn lobby prints US Eastern time; 04:00 EDT = 08:00Z.

snapshot_under_test.glance_claim_checked: The executive summary states 33 of 33 active fixtures with a directional pick, 15 from an external betting line and 18 from a research model. 10 market + 2 bookmaker + 2 consensus + 1 reference = 15 money-backed rows; the relay row is counted inside bookmaker; 18 model rows. The arithmetic matches the published counts.

checks.claim: Sampled published fixtures are the same fixtures Hotspawn lists, at the same start time, including cards that carry no 'View Match' link yet.
checks.detail: Read the whole CS2 Closing Soon and Upcoming list and matched 23 of the 33 published fixtures name-for-name and start-time-for-start-time (the four cards without a 'View Match' link — FaZe-BC.Game, SinnerS-Eternal Fire, NEXORA-K27, UPGRADE-Virtus.pro — are published in the snapshot, so a missing outbound link is not a missing fixture). The page prints US Eastern time; UNiTY-Apogee 10:00 EDT = 14:00Z matches the snapshot's starts_at. The remaining ten published fixtures were not re-read in this audit; the publisher's own three-way API/lobby/CS2-lobby reconciliation at 05:36Z returned 'complete' in the published collection record, and the next refresh re-checks all of them.

checks.claim: Fixtures published by Hotspawn after the snapshot's observation are not a coverage defect; they are picked up by the next scheduled refresh.
checks.detail: The 07:36Z lobby additionally lists eight later fixtures absent from the 05:36Z snapshot: DFRAG Invitational 2026 (Ground Zero-Off Chops, NEXVOID-Alter Ego, FlyQuest-Staqued, Rooster-Abyssal, 25-26 Oct) and Tesla Cup 2026 (B8-K27, Alliance-FaZe, Luminosity-HOTU, Envy-..., 27 Oct). These carry lock countdowns of 3-5 days, so they were not open at the snapshot instant; the four-hour publisher collects them on its next run. Recorded for transparency, not as a flag.

checks.claim: Every sampled model probability reproduces from Valve's official published points with the site's published formula.
checks.source_type: official Valve regional standings, fetched through the GitHub Contents API
checks.note: The published percentages are rounded to one decimal, so an absolute difference of up to 0.0005 is expected. Banda Chuya has a second, incomplete Valve row (402 points, two players); the collected figure used the complete five-player row (801), which is the published uniqueness rule.

checks.claim: The HLTV match pages the ladder cites exist and describe the same fixture Hotspawn schedules.
checks.source_type: HLTV match page, read by hand (the automated runner receives HTTP 403)
checks.detail: UNiTY vs Betclic, 22 October, Best of 3, Stake Ranked Episode 6 Closed Qualifier; matches Hotspawn fixture 1082882 at 2026-10-22T14:00:00Z. A second page, https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399105/bushido-wildcats-vs-ex-6666-nodwin-clutch-series-13, is the identity evidence cited for fixture 1079188 in data/origination/aliases.json. HLTV is used as an identity/ranking source only: no HLTV price and no HLTV fan vote enters any probability.

checks.claim: The UNiTY-Apogee consensus row is consistent with the prediction market it names.
checks.detail: Published snapshot value: UNiTY 41.8% / Apogee Betclic 58.2% (median of Polymarket + Thunderpick + Bovada at 05:36Z). At 08:30Z Polymarket showed unity 43c / bca 58c, the same side and a comparable magnitude. The dated 05:36Z value is the one published; this check only confirms the row is not reversed.

checks.claim: The phone summary published a consensus row under the link text 'Bookmaker'.
checks.result: defect confirmed and fixed in AEB-2
checks.detail: Glance rows for UPGRADE-Virtus.pro (method consensus, source 'Bovada + Pinnacle') and UNiTY-Apogee (method consensus, source 'Polymarket + Thunderpick + Bovada') both read 'Bookmaker' and linked a single provider URL (Bovada and Polymarket respectively). The row data was correct; the rendering label was not. Fixed by analysis_source_label() and locked by tests/test_aae76fb3_summary_labels.py.

checks.claim: The executive-summary unresolved tile read '0 without a line - 18 model-only', which reads as a contradiction.
checks.result: defect confirmed; already fixed on main by session 4c972a51, preserved here
checks.detail: The '0' is the unresolved count, not the no-betting-line count. While this session was working, session arena-4c972a51 rewrote the tile on main to '{unresolved} without a pick · {model} from research models · why + sources' and linked a dedicated /unresolved/ page (PR #174). This branch keeps that wording; tests/test_aae76fb3_summary_labels.py pins it so the ambiguous 'without a line' cannot return. No duplicate edit was made.

not_verified_here: The saved Polymarket/Kalshi/Thunderpick/Bovada/Pinnacle original responses inside the deployed artifact were not re-downloaded in this session (the Actions artifact endpoint is not reachable from the sandbox). Their replay is enforced by the publisher itself (scripts/validate.py, scripts/audit_rows.py, tests/test_source_integrity.py) and by the live deployment verification step.
HLTV ranking values were not re-read row by row; the HLTV rung did not price any of the sampled rows.
Map vetoes, stand-ins and current lineups are not verified by this audit, exactly as every model row states.
